tickets.text: Hi, I'm working with the Inventory Health e1b8e1 report and looking at the Handled Quantity measure. I exported data for movement 900202 twice within a short window and got different results each time. The first export had no row at all for this movement, and the second export showed a receipt of 11 units with an event date in September. Both exports were pulled from the same application source and I didn't change any filters between them. Why would the September history for movement 900202 show up in one export but not the other?

I'm comparing two exports I pulled from the application source for movement 900203 within a short window. In the earlier export there was no row for this movement at all, but in the export I pulled just seconds later there is a receipt of 13 units with an event date in September. I'm looking at this through Inventory Health e1b8e1 using the Handled Quantity measure. Can someone explain why the September history for movement 900203 would appear differently between those two exports?
